entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Anderson & Francis (2012), Astronomy Letters 38, 331 (XHIP), Hipparcos astrometry, VizieR V/137D/XHIP row HIP = 82273: position at J1991.25; Gaia cannot see the star. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 82273: distance 119.76 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.018), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 119.76 +/- 2.156 pc; Gaia DR3 cannot see the star. Proper motion: VizieR V/137D/XHIP row HIP = 82273 (same row): 17.97, -31.65 mas/yr. Radial velocity from Anderson & Francis (2012), Astronomy Letters 38, 331 (XHIP), Hipparcos astrometry, HIP 82273: RV -3 +/- 0.1 km/s (quality A).

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 111.552 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 82273: radius 111.552 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 3713.19 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.061) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 4269 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 82273: effective temperature 4269 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.065).

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: Pulkovo spectrophotometric catalogue, table 5 (320-1080 nm, 2.5 nm steps, 10 nm resolution, absolute flux in W m^-2 m^-1): Alekseeva et al. (1996, 1997), Baltic Astronomy 5, 603 and 6, 481; VizieR III/201. Atria is HR 6217., cross-checked against Burnashev (1985), Abastumani Astrophys. Obs. Bull. 59, 83; VizieR III/126, part2 record 223 (BS 6217) (1 levels apart at most, the threshold is 12), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffd292. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: HD 150798 is not in the library; gaia-xp: the star is placed by a catalogue row, so no Gaia DR3 source is read for it; kiehling: HR 6217 is not among its 60 stars; kharitonov: HR 6217 is not in the catalogue; pulkovo: used.
